title: Chapter 2667 - 75: Murderous Intent_3
content:
Chapter 2667: Chapter 75: Murderous Intent_3

Ba Shan and Bachuan hesitated a little.

"Gentleman, how did you know that Bi Jie would definitely want to kill me?" Dan Zhu frowned and asked Mo Hua.

Mo Hua said to Dan Zhu, "There’s nothing strange about it. If I were Bi Jie, I would definitely kill you first too. If not now, there won’t be such a good chance later..."

Dan Zhu: "..."

"Of course," Mo Hua rubbed his fingers, calculating in his mind, and then had to admit, "Wanting to kill Bi Jie, at the moment this chance is indeed rather slim. I’m just reminding you all so you have some preparation in your heart."

"Two things: First, prevent Bi Jie from making a move, killing Young Master Dan Zhu."

"Second, watch for the opportunity, strike first to kill Bi Jie."

Mo Hua’s tone became somewhat serious.

Dan Zhu and the others thought about it, and nodded.

What Mo Hua reminded was actually right.

The intention to harm others should not exist, but the intention to guard against others must be present.

No matter whether they kill Bi Jie or not, they must guard against Bi Jie’s murderous schemes.

After that, Ba Shan and Bachuan protected Dan Zhu from both sides, and Chi Feng also kept a sharp-eyed watch, following behind Dan Zhu.

Mo Hua walked side by side with Dan Zhu, also enjoying "Young Master" level protection.

Of course, the primary intention of everyone was to rescue people.

After rescuing the Danque Clan people, leaving this trouble-filled place as soon as possible to avoid further conflict with the Bi Fang Tribe is the best course.

Otherwise, when the mixed battle erupts, who knows how many people will die.

Mo Hua actually didn’t want to see this scene.

After all, the genius Dan Zhu and these one hundred Barbarian Soldiers had already been secretly regarded as "his own" people by Mo Hua.

They are the living forces for him to develop his power and complete the next stage of the plan.

If they are lost, Mo Hua would also feel distressed.

Only the Danque Tribe people, in the valley of the Shugu Skill Department, went around in a whole circle, still not finding the place where the "live provisions" were imprisoned.

Nor did they see any sign of the Danque Tribe People, or even members from other tribes captured for sacrifice.

Mo Hua asked Iron Skill Bone.

Iron Skill Bone just looked terrified, saying that he didn’t know anything.

He is the leader of the "Wandering Tribe," roaming outside every day, killing and stealing, randomly picking a cave on a mountain as a base.

He’s only been to the skill department here a few times, offered "provisions" a few times, his status does not qualify him to stay here long-term.

Mo Hua looked at him meaningfully, but did not ask more questions.

And the whole Shugu Skill Department is very large.

Wind and water flow between the valleys, the air easily disperses.

Mo Hua did not use computational power, to avoid alerting the enemy, instead, he and the Danque Tribe people simply relied on vision and Divine Sense to find the way.

After searching like this, there was no result.

Eventually, winding around and around, they finally arrived at the deepest part of the Shugu Skill Department, in front of a huge Stone Palace.

This Stone Palace is built directly into the mountains.

From outside, one can only see two huge stone doors that are integrated with the cliff walls.

On each side of the stone doors, are carved with images of two unknown White Bone Demon Beasts.

These two White Bone Demon Beasts face each other, like two "door gods," guarding the doors, locking all secrets and air energy inside the Stone Palace.

And at this moment, not only had the Danque Tribe people arrived in front of this Stone Palace.

Most of the Barbarian Soldiers from the Bi Fang Tribe had already been stationed here.

Various small and medium tribes belonging to the Bi Fang Tribe were guarding all around.

Before the door, some loyal followers of the Shugu Tribe, wearing White Bone makeup, were still slogging it out with the Bi Fang Tribe to defend the Stone Palace.

But they were simply no match for the Bi Fang Tribe.

In less than an hour, they were slaughtered completely by the Bi Fang Tribe.

Blood and severed limbs scattered all over the ground.

The one who killed the most was the Bi Fang Tribe’s Young Master, Bi Jie, in the Golden Core Middle Stage, dressed in black, with a dark green ferocious bird totem on his chest, wielding the fierce blade of Bi Fang.

After killing the remnants of the Shugu Tribe, with the situation under control, Bi Jie finally looked towards Dan Zhu and the others, his face somewhat cold, yet also a bit excited:

"You really are... an evil spirit..."
